name: team_planning_attention
description: List what needs attention in a scenario of a Team Planning plan the caller is in: changes that still resolve but no longer fit, often because a scenario it follows changed later. Each item has the subject_id and facet that no longer fit (a person's assignment, a position, a unit, a succession, a reporting line, a budget line, or a place's capacity as capacity:<unit or position id>, or capacity:unassigned for someone in no unit), a reason, and the change it belongs to: its kind, the scenario that made it and its event_id. That is the later to land of the subject's own change and the change that broke it, such as a parent unit's retirement; change is null when nothing in the plan explains it. It also checks each person: placed nowhere, over or under 100% allocated (an unknown total is neither), still in the plan after the Org Graph has them leave, no manager (except the head of the tree), or a manager who is gone, has left, or is in or owns none of their units nor the unit directly above one. Once a capacity model is chosen for any role or family, even one no place takes, each place no model covers is listed too, except a leaver's, a forgotten person's override and a closed position's. Items come grouped by check, in a fixed order, then by subject_id and reason. Fix an item with a new change, or by pinning or clearing one. `names` maps each person id to a name; a forgotten person reads as "Former member". Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline. Omit it for the baseline.
